passages.text: And God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah and his sons.
God blessed Noah and his sons.
God said to them, "Be fruitful."
God said, "Multiply."
God said, "Fill the earth."
passages.original: וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־ נֹ֖חַ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֑יו וַיֹּ֧אמֶר לָהֶ֛ם פְּר֥וּ וּרְב֖וּ וּמִלְא֥וּ אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The fear and dread of you will fall on every living creature on the earth, every bird of the air, every creature that crawls on the ground, and all the fish of the sea. They are delivered into your hand.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah and his sons.
God gave them authority over all animals.
Every animal on the earth will fear you.
Every bird in the sky will fear you.
Every creature that crawls on the ground will fear you.
All the fish in the sea will fear you.
God has placed all these creatures under your power.
passages.original: וּמוֹרַאֲכֶ֤ם וְחִתְּכֶם֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עַ֚ל כָּל־ חַיַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם בְּכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּרְמֹ֧שׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֛ה וּֽבְכָל־ דְּגֵ֥י הַיָּ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶ֥ם נִתָּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Everything that lives and moves will be food for you; just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you all things.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah and his sons.
God gave them a command.
God said, “You may eat any living thing that moves.
I give you all these animals for food.
Before, I gave you green plants to eat.
Now, I give you everything.”
passages.original: כָּל־ רֶ֙מֶשׂ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּא־ חַ֔י לָכֶ֥ם יִהְיֶ֖ה לְאָכְלָ֑ה כְּיֶ֣רֶק עֵ֔שֶׂב נָתַ֥תִּי לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ כֹּֽל׃

passages.text: But you must not eat meat with its lifeblood still in it.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah and his sons.
God gave them instructions for living after the flood.
God allowed them to eat animals for food.
God said, “You must not eat meat that still has its lifeblood in it.”
Do not eat flesh with blood in it.
Blood is the life of the animal.
Respect the life in the blood.
Do not eat meat while its blood remains in it.
passages.original: אַךְ־ בָּשָׂ֕ר בְּנַפְשׁ֥וֹ דָמ֖וֹ לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ׃

passages.text: And surely I will require the life of any man or beast by whose hand your lifeblood is shed. I will demand an accounting from anyone who takes the life of his fellow man: Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man his blood will be shed; for in His own image God has made mankind.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah and his sons.
God gave them commands after the flood.
God said, “I will require a reckoning for your lifeblood.
If any animal kills a person, I will require its life.
If any person kills another person, I will require his life.
If someone sheds the blood of a human, another human will shed his blood.
God made mankind in His own image.
God values human life because He created people in His image.
passages.original: וְאַ֨ךְ אֶת־ דִּמְכֶ֤ם לְנַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם֙ אֶדְרֹ֔שׁ מִיַּ֥ד כָּל־ חַיָּ֖ה אֶדְרְשֶׁ֑נּוּ וּמִיַּ֣ד הָֽאָדָ֗ם מִיַּד֙ אִ֣ישׁ אָחִ֔יו אֶדְרֹ֖שׁ אֶת־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ הָֽאָדָֽם׃ שֹׁפֵךְ֙ דַּ֣ם הָֽאָדָ֔ם בָּֽאָדָ֖ם דָּמ֣וֹ יִשָּׁפֵ֑ךְ כִּ֚י בְּצֶ֣לֶם אֱלֹהִ֔ים עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת־ הָאָדָֽם׃

passages.text: But as for you, be fruitful and multiply; spread out across the earth and multiply upon it.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah and his sons.
God commanded them.
God said, "Be fruitful."
God said, "Multiply."
God said, "Fill the earth."
God said, "Increase in number on the earth."
passages.original: וְאַתֶּ֖ם פְּר֣וּ וּרְב֑וּ שִׁרְצ֥וּ בָאָ֖רֶץ וּרְבוּ־ בָֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: Then God said to Noah and his sons with him, “Behold, I now establish My covenant with you and your descendants after you, and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock, and every beast of the earth—every living thing that came out of the ark.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God also spoke to Noah’s sons who were with him.
God said, “I am now making a covenant with you.
I am making this covenant with your descendants after you.
I am also making this covenant with every living creature that is with you.
This includes the birds.
This includes the livestock.
This includes every beast of the earth with you.
This includes every living thing that came out of the ark.
This covenant is for all the animals of the earth.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ נֹ֔חַ וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֥יו אִתּ֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃ וַאֲנִ֕י הִנְנִ֥י מֵקִ֛ים אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְאֶֽת־ זַרְעֲכֶ֖ם אַֽחֲרֵיכֶֽם׃ וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ נֶ֤פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתְּכֶ֔ם בָּע֧וֹף בַּבְּהֵמָ֛ה וּֽבְכָל־ חַיַּ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ אִתְּכֶ֑ם מִכֹּל֙ יֹצְאֵ֣י הַתֵּבָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל חַיַּ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And I establish My covenant with you: Never again will all life be cut off by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah and his sons.
God made a promise to them.
God said, “I establish my covenant with you.
No flood will ever destroy all life again.
No flood will ever destroy the earth again.”
passages.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִי֙ אִתְּכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֧ת כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֛ר ע֖וֹד מִמֵּ֣י הַמַּבּ֑וּל וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד מַבּ֖וּל לְשַׁחֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And God said, “This is the sign of the covenant I am making between Me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come: I have set My rainbow in the clouds, and it will be a sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah and his sons.
God made a covenant with Noah, his sons, and every living creature with them.
God said, “This is the sign of the covenant I am giving.
This covenant is between Me, you, and every living creature with you.
This covenant will last for all generations.
I have set My rainbow in the clouds.
The rainbow will be a sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים זֹ֤את אֽוֹת־ הַבְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֣י נֹתֵ֗ן בֵּינִי֙ וּבֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵ֛ין כָּל־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתְּכֶ֑ם לְדֹרֹ֖ת עוֹלָֽם׃ אֶת־ קַשְׁתִּ֕י נָתַ֖תִּי בֶּֽעָנָ֑ן וְהָֽיְתָה֙ לְא֣וֹת בְּרִ֔ית בֵּינִ֖י וּבֵ֥ין הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Whenever I form clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will remember My covenant between Me and you and every living creature of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah and his family.
God made a covenant with them.
God also made this covenant with every living creature on earth.
God said, “Whenever I form clouds over the earth, the rainbow will appear in the clouds.
When I see the rainbow, I will remember My covenant.
This covenant is between Me, you, and every living creature of every kind.
The waters will never again become a flood to destroy all life.”
passages.original: וְהָיָ֕ה בְּעַֽנְנִ֥י עָנָ֖ן עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְנִרְאֲתָ֥ה הַקֶּ֖שֶׁת בֶּעָנָֽן׃ וְזָכַרְתִּ֣י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר בֵּינִי֙ וּבֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וּבֵ֛ין כָּל־ נֶ֥פֶשׁ חַיָּ֖ה בְּכָל־ בָּשָׂ֑ר וְלֹֽא־ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה ע֤וֹד הַמַּ֙יִם֙ לְמַבּ֔וּל לְשַׁחֵ֖ת כָּל־ בָּשָֽׂר׃

passages.text: And whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of every kind that is on the earth.”
passages.sermon:
God made a covenant with every living creature on earth.
This covenant is everlasting.
God set a rainbow in the clouds as a sign of this covenant.
Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, God sees it.
When God sees the rainbow, He remembers His everlasting covenant.
This covenant is between God and every living creature on the earth.
passages.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה הַקֶּ֖שֶׁת בֶּֽעָנָ֑ן וּרְאִיתִ֗יהָ לִזְכֹּר֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם בֵּ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֔ים וּבֵין֙ כָּל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֔ה בְּכָל־ בָּשָׂ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: So God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between Me and every creature on the earth.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Noah.
God said, “I have made a covenant.
This covenant is between Me and every living creature on the earth.
This is the sign of that covenant.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ נֹ֑חַ זֹ֤את אֽוֹת־ הַבְּרִית֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲקִמֹ֔תִי בֵּינִ֕י וּבֵ֥ין כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ

passages.text: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.
passages.sermon:
Noah had three sons.
Their names were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
These sons came out of the ark with Noah.
Ham was the father of Canaan.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְי֣וּ בְנֵי־ נֹ֗חַ הַיֹּֽצְאִים֙ מִן־ הַתֵּבָ֔ה שֵׁ֖ם וְחָ֣ם וָיָ֑פֶת וְחָ֕ם ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י כְנָֽעַן׃

passages.text: These three were the sons of Noah, and from them the whole earth was populated.
passages.sermon: Noah had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.\r\nAll people on earth came from these three sons.
passages.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־ נֹ֑חַ וּמֵאֵ֖לֶּה נָֽפְצָ֥ה כָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Now Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.
passages.sermon: Noah was a man who worked the soil.\r\nNoah began a new task.\r\nNoah planted a vineyard.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥חֶל נֹ֖חַ אִ֣ישׁ הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וַיִּטַּ֖ע כָּֽרֶם׃

passages.text: But when he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and uncovered himself inside his tent.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a man of the soil.
Noah planted a vineyard.
Noah drank some of the wine from his vineyard.
Noah became drunk.
Noah uncovered himself inside his tent.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥שְׁתְּ מִן־ הַיַּ֖יִן וַיִּשְׁכָּ֑ר וַיִּתְגַּ֖ל בְּת֥וֹךְ אָהֳלֹֽה׃

passages.text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father’s nakedness and told his two brothers outside.
passages.sermon:
Ham was the father of Canaan.
Ham saw his father Noah’s nakedness.
Ham told his two brothers about it.
Ham spoke to them while they were outside.
passages.original: וַיַּ֗רְא חָ֚ם אֲבִ֣י כְנַ֔עַן אֵ֖ת עֶרְוַ֣ת אָבִ֑יו וַיַּגֵּ֥ד לִשְׁנֵֽי־ אֶחָ֖יו בַּחֽוּץ׃

passages.text: Then Shem and Japheth took a garment and placed it across their shoulders, and walking backward, they covered their father’s nakedness. Their faces were turned away so that they did not see their father’s nakedness.
passages.sermon:
Shem and Japheth were two of Noah’s sons.
They took a garment.
They placed the garment across both their shoulders.
They walked backward into the tent.
They covered their father’s nakedness with the garment.
They turned their faces away.
They did not see their father’s nakedness.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ שֵׁ֨ם וָיֶ֜פֶת אֶת־ הַשִּׂמְלָ֗ה וַיָּשִׂ֙ימוּ֙ עַל־ שְׁכֶ֣ם שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ אֲחֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית וַיְכַסּ֕וּ אֵ֖ת עֶרְוַ֣ת אֲבִיהֶ֑ם וּפְנֵיהֶם֙ אֲחֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית וְעֶרְוַ֥ת אֲבִיהֶ֖ם לֹ֥א רָאֽוּ׃

passages.text: When Noah awoke from his drunkenness and learned what his youngest son had done to him, he said, “Cursed be Canaan! A servant of servants shall he be to his brothers.”
passages.sermon:
Noah was the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Noah survived the flood.
Noah drank wine and became drunk.
Noah fell asleep.
Noah awoke from his drunkenness.
Noah learned what his youngest son had done to him.
Noah spoke.
Noah said, “Cursed be Canaan!”
Noah said, “Canaan will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”
passages.original: וַיִּ֥יקֶץ נֹ֖חַ מִיֵּינ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֕דַע אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָ֥שָׂה־ ל֖וֹ בְּנ֥וֹ הַקָּטָֽן׃ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָר֣וּר כְּנָ֑עַן עֶ֥בֶד עֲבָדִ֖ים יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לְאֶחָֽיו׃

passages.text: He also declared: “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem! May Canaan be the servant of Shem.
passages.sermon:
Noah was the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Noah spoke after he awoke from his drunkenness.
Noah said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem.”
Noah said, “May Canaan be the servant of Shem.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בָּר֥וּךְ יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹ֣הֵי שֵׁ֑ם וִיהִ֥י כְנַ֖עַן עֶ֥בֶד לָֽמוֹ׃

passages.text: May God expand the territory of Japheth; may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be his servant.”
passages.sermon:
Noah spoke about his sons.
Noah said, “May God make Japheth’s territory large.
May Japheth live in the tents of Shem.
May Canaan serve Japheth and Shem as a servant.”
passages.original: יַ֤פְתְּ אֱלֹהִים֙ לְיֶ֔פֶת וְיִשְׁכֹּ֖ן בְּאָֽהֳלֵי־ שֵׁ֑ם וִיהִ֥י כְנַ֖עַן עֶ֥בֶד לָֽמוֹ׃

passages.text: After the flood, Noah lived 350 years.
passages.sermon:
Noah was a man who survived the flood.
The flood was a great disaster that covered the earth.
After the flood ended, Noah continued to live.
Noah lived for 350 more years after the flood.
passages.original: וַֽיְחִי־ נֹ֖חַ אַחַ֣ר הַמַּבּ֑וּל שְׁלֹ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַֽחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: So Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
passages.sermon: Noah was a man chosen by God.\r\nNoah lived for 950 years.\r\nNoah died after these years.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־ יְמֵי־ נֹ֔חַ תְּשַׁ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃פ
